content:
Apple TV+ currently boasts a strong slate of series, with main titles such as 《Slow Horses》, 《Ted Lasso》, 《Dark Matter》, and the new comedy 《Brothers》 starring Matthew McConaughey. In addition, more new works are about to debut. Below is all the new content premiering on Apple TV+ in October.

《The Last First: Winter K2》

  • Release date: October 2
  • Type: Movie
  • Category: Documentary

《The Last First: Winter K2》, directed by Amir Bar-Lev, tells a complex, thrilling, and moving chapter that examines the extreme mountaineering industry and its ever-changing culture. The film focuses on a 2021 expedition involving climber John Snorri Sigurjónsson (from Iceland) and a team composed of Pakistani father and son Ali Sadpara and Sajid Sadpara, with the goal of becoming the first team to summit K2 in winter, setting off when the environment on the mountain is at its most brutal. These people soon find themselves embarking on this perilous journey together with KOL influencer climbers and their film crews, commercial expedition clients, and Nepal's celebrity climber Nims and his team of Sherpas. 《The Last First: Winter K2》 takes viewers to the icy peaks and unpredictable weather of K2, revealing an unexpected, layered story—about strategy and determination, class and social hierarchy, money and power—all unfolding in a life-and-death environment.

《The Sisters Grimm》(Season 2)

  • Release date: October 2
  • Type: TV series
  • Category: Kids and Family

Two sisters, who are orphans, live in a small town inhabited by characters from fantasy stories and fairy tales, facing challenges from heroes and villains while investigating the mystery of their disappearance from home. 《The Sisters Grimm》 blends exploration, fantasy, and adventure, delivering important lessons for viewers of all ages.

《Small Prophets》

  • Release date: October 7
  • Type: TV series
  • Category: Comedy

《Small Prophets》 is a comedy about eccentric Michael Sleep (played by Pearce Quigley), who has been living an ordinary life since his beloved Clea disappeared seven years ago. He works at a DIY store, visits his father Brian (played by Sir Michael Palin), and hopes for Clea's return. One day, Brian shares with him an ancient recipe, with ingredients including rainwater, horse manure, and a touch of alchemy. With the recipe in hand, Michael attempts with some skepticism to create homunculi—magical spirits that can predict the future—hoping they can answer the question on his mind: 'Will I ever see Clea again?'

《Matchbox The Movie》

  • Release date: October 9
  • Type: Movie
  • Category: Action

Adapted from Mattel's iconic toy brand, 《Matchbox The Movie》 is an action-laden adventure spanning the globe, telling the story of childhood pals whose lives are rewritten when their long-missing former leader, CIA undercover agent Sean (played by John Cena), returns to their town, inadvertently pulling them into a wild global chase to save the planet.

《Tenzing》

  • Release date: October 16
  • Type: Movie
  • Category: Drama

Based on a true story, 《Tenzing》 tells the little-known story of Tenzing Norgay (played by Genden Phuntsok). He is a talented Himalayan climber who, together with New Zealand mountaineer Edmund Hillary (played by Tom Hiddleston), became one of the first to summit Mount Everest. Encouraged by his wife Dawa (played by Thinley Lhamo) and supported by expedition secretary Jill Henderson (played by Caitríona Balfe), they convince Colonel John Hunt (played by Willem Dafoe) that Tenzing should be a member of the British climbing team rather than just a logistical staffer serving them. Western climbers view 'Everest' as an objective to conquer, while Tenzing reveres 'Chomolungma' as a sacred mother goddess. The subsequent climb is tested by tensions between backgrounds, classes, and competing ambitions, and is made arduous by the dangers of the mountain itself. But at the roof of the world, empires, class, and ambition all fade away, leaving two outsiders bound by mutual respect and trust—for Tenzing, a moment to fulfill a lifelong dream and spiritual calling.

《Where's Wanda?》(Season 2)

  • Release date: October 21
  • Type: TV series
  • Category: Black comedy

Apple TV+'s first German-language series, 《Where's Wanda?》, is a black comedy about married couple Dedo and Carlotta Klatt anxiously searching for their missing 17-year-old daughter Wanda. Wanda vanished without a reason months ago, and the police have been unable to find her, so the family decides to take things into their own hands, using surveillance equipment obtained with the help of their tech-savvy son Ole. Posing as utility company workers, they install wiretaps around the neighborhood and half the suburbs, and discover that their neighbors are not what they appear behind closed doors.

《Nocturne》

  • Release date: October 30
  • Type: TV series
  • Category: Crime drama

The series tells the story of Jonah Lynn (played by Liev Schreiber). He is a veteran turned murder detective, weary of the hustle and bustle of the streets of Philadelphia, who moves to a small town in western Pennsylvania for a quiet life. But when the town and his family come under attack from cunning serial killer Jurek Walter (played by Graham), Jonah must protect all that he holds dear. When the urgent search for Jurek's last missing victim forces Jonah to send his goddaughter—FBI agent Saga Bauer (played by Beetz)—to take on Jurek, how far will Jonah actually go?

New episodes: 《Slow Horses》, 《Brothers》, and more

Apple TV+ will also release new episodes of several currently airing series in October, including:

  • 《Ted Lasso》: The comedy series starring Jason Sudeikis will air through October 7
  • 《Last Seen》: The crime thriller series will air through October 7
  • 《Slow Horses》: The highly acclaimed British spy drama will air through October 21
  • 《Dark Matter》: The sci-fi drama starring Joel Edgerton will air through October 30
  • 《Brothers》: The comedy starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson will air through November 4

Which of Apple TV+'s October releases are you planning to watch? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV+ costs $14.99 per month, or is available at a discount via the Apple One bundle.
